claude.performance_metric: over $220M annualized cost synergies; 3-year integration program concluded; VWR integration expenses declined $36.2M (2018) to $9.9M (2020) to immaterial (2021)
claude.rationale: No product/process interface disruption is documented: VWR remained "the primary ordering platform for our customers" and its trade name continued to be amortized as an in-use finite-lived intangible, indicating operational alignment rather than incoherence (p4=0). No process/organization fracture is documented: the integration program concluded on its originally envisioned three-year schedule with over $220M in synergies, integration expenses fell steadily and became immaterial by 2021, VWR-origin pension plans were merged/continued, and at least one former VWR senior executive was retained in a combined-company role (p5=0). The slice contains no evidence of archetype incoherence or of irreconcilable business-model value-capture logics over the outcome window.
